rationale: Hardware storage constraints and strict data-leakage prevention

group_b_bdd100k_dev.role: Target domain validation & hyperparameter selection (strictly disjoint)

group_c_bdd100k_test.role: Target domain locked evaluation (strictly isolated until frozen)

group_d_bdd100k_train.risk_assessment: Using Group B or Group C images for training would induce fatal target-domain test leakage. Downloading full BDD100K 100k-image train set (~18 GB compressed, >50 GB uncompressed) exceeds local storage budget and violates Mission 5 non-negotiable rules.

alternative_domain_adaptation.transfer_target: BDD100K (Group B Dev / Group C Locked Test)
alternative_domain_adaptation.scientific_justification: Synthetic weather injection (Koschmieder atmospheric fog, directional rain streaks, defocus blur) exposes the network to continuous distributions of adverse weather degradations without requiring massive supervised external driving datasets.
